steps: Open 학생서비스 (Student Services) and go to 졸업 (Graduation).
Undergraduates: choose 졸업신청 > 학부졸업신청 및 현황.
Graduate students: choose 논문관련 > 논문/실적심사 신청 및 수료현황.
Check your major's status, thesis review result and 학위기 (diploma) details.

english: To make it easier and more convenient for students to manage their graduation and completion (수료, completion of required coursework without a degree) schedules, the Academic Affairs Office (학사과) has developed a program for checking graduation and completion status, and
plans to launch it officially in the 2nd semester of 2026 (in September).
Before the official launch, a pilot run will be held as follows to improve the service. Please take note.
가. Program start date and time: 10 Aug 2026 (Mon) 13:00
나. Graduation and completion status check program
- (Undergraduate) 학생서비스 (Student Services) > 졸업 (Graduation) > 졸업신청 (Graduation Application) > 학부졸업신청 및 현황 (Undergraduate Graduation Application and Status)
- (Graduate) 학생서비스 (Student Services) > 졸업 (Graduation) > 논문관련 (Thesis-Related) > 논문/실적심사 신청 및 수료현황 (Application for Thesis/Achievement Review and Completion Status)
- Progress and results of graduation, completion, and thesis/achievement review (논문/실적심사, evaluation of the thesis or research output) for each major
